Introduction: ChatGPT has a dialogue interface and can interpret complex free-text queries or prompts, responding to users with full sentences or paragraphs, mimicking human writing styles.

Conclusions: Our most recent preclerkship cohort outperforms the average performance of ChatGPT but there is a risk of underperforming students not being identified in a timely manner if the technology is wrongfully applied by students on assessments.
